ValidationRule.description: Location is required when At Fault Party is 'Plant / Operations' or 'Warehouse'.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: IF( AND( OR( ISPICKVAL(PMC_SS_AtFaultParty__c, 'Plant / Operations') , ISPICKVAL(PMC_SS_AtFaultParty__c, 'Warehouse') ), ISBLANK(PMC_SS_Location__c) ), true, false )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Location is required when At Fault Party is 'Plant / Operations' or 'Warehouse'.
